title: Data of the four-stage absolute Gabber modification
statement:
Use locally Noetherian fs log schemes and their log morphisms [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], finite log group actions [def-per-fs-log-group-action], very tameness [def-per-very-tame-fs-log-action] and strictness [def-per-strict-log-morphism]. Define the free open as the union of invariant opens with trivial geometric stabilizers. A scheme is quasi-excellent when every affine coordinate ring is quasi-excellent [def-exc-excellent-ring]. An input triple has integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], Noetherian, separated, quasi-excellent log regular underlying pair and tame generically free action. A boundary is the radical ideal whose support is the log triviality complement. It is G-strict if each irreducible component has equal or disjoint translates; abelian inertia means that any two elements fixing a geometric point commute. A permissible center, not necessarily contained in the old boundary, is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] and is etale locally generated by a nonempty subset of a full regular parameter system [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters] in which the boundary is a product of distinct parameters. A subgroup fixed ideal represents the equalizer on every scheme-valued test point.

An equivariant normalized tower is a finite sequence, including length zero, of fs log schemes with invariant coherent nowhere-dense ideal centers, log-equivariant arrows which are normalized blowups in the sense of [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization] and [def-trf-normalized-blowup], identified initial triple, and projections satisfying the identity and composition equations. An ordinary step is an isomorphism over the preceding level with the ordinary blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Strict transforms are the scheme-theoretic closures from the complement of the actual center. A minimal-fixed-family round initializes every nontrivial subgroup fixed ideal, blows up the union of all nonempty minimal members, replaces every member by its strict transform, and ends with all members empty.

The first-stage predicate means a saturated log blowup tower with regular log regular final source. The second-stage data track the old boundary, blowing up its reduced closed maximal branch stratum, with branch counts as in [def-trf-normal-crossings-branch-count], until its strict transform is empty; all steps are ordinary and saturated log blowups on regular schemes and the final boundary is strict normal crossings [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary] and G-strict. The third-stage data are finitely many complete fixed-family rounds of ordinary permissible blowups, replacing the boundary by its strict transform together with the exceptional divisor at every step, retaining regularity and G-strict strict normal crossings boundary, and ending with abelian inertia and free complement.

A rigidification is an equivariant enlargement of the boundary on the same scheme to a very tame log regular strict normal crossings pair. A rigidified quotient is its finite surjective invariant log quotient with log regular input to a common saturated resolution rule. Use the strict etale tower procedures and their ordered comparisons of [def-trf-strict-etale-log-blowup-procedure]. A rigidified construction resolves this quotient by that rule, pulls every stage and log ideal back in the fs category, and identifies every resulting scheme and arrow with the original-boundary normalized tower; its ordinary ideal centers are generated by the pulled log ideals on every strict local stalk. Forgetting the auxiliary boundary changes only log structures. A fourth-stage procedure assigns towers to all Noetherian separated quasi-excellent regular log regular tame abelian-inertia G-strict strict normal crossings pairs with free complement, including disconnected inputs. Its output is log regular and very tame with precisely inverse-image original boundary; it admits affine surjective quasi-compact strict inert etale rigidified covers. For every admissible input and every auxiliary rigidification and quotient, its same tower is the rigidified construction, expressing independence of all auxiliary boundary choices. For every strict equivariant inertia-preserving map, including group homomorphisms H to G, it supplies ordered contracted scheme-pullback comparisons retaining exactly nonunit centers, respecting identity and composition. Inertia-preserving means isomorphisms on actual geometric stabilizers.

Four-stage data over a triple consist of successive first, second, third and common fourth-stage towers on the preceding final source. Their composite and source are the actual composites and final scheme. The output predicate asserts integral log regular very tame source, equivariance, projectivity in the projective-bundle sense [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism], realization of the composite by a finite normalized tower, isomorphism on the dense intersection of the original triviality and free opens, and precisely its inverse-image boundary. For every affine Noetherian B and finite type quasi-projective structural map X to B, it additionally asserts H-projectivity [def-kun-projective] and finite type quasi-projectivity of the source over B. Here relative quasi-projectivity means a locally closed immersion into some finite projective space over B, using universe lifts of its finite coordinate type.

Existing normalized towers are Monoscheme.NormalizedTower/IsNormalizedBlowup; actions FSLogGroupAction; boundary IsStrictNormalCrossingsBoundary. Upstream IsQuasiProjective is only over a field; IsPermissibleCenter is explicitly boundary-contained, unsuitable for stage three centers outside the old boundary. blueprint search four-stage: 0; rigidification: 2 unrelated Picard units.

reviewed_lean.note: Read the item, all 7 stmt_deps, the new def-per-gabber-modification-data module (502 lines) and the StrictEtaleLogBlowupProcedure (B) repair against ILO VIII 5.3.5-5.6.1. Input = integral/Noetherian/qe/separated/log regular plus tame and generically free; Z = trivialityLocus complement, F = complement of the sup of free invariant opens; Output gives integral log regular very tame equivariant source, IsProjectiveBundle, a composite realized by one normalized Tower, iso over triv ∩ free (dense), source boundary = preimage, and for every affine Noetherian B with finite-type quasi-projective p: IsHProjective, quasi-projective and finite type. Stages 1-3 match the node; unrestricted Permissible is needed because IsPermissibleCenter requires the center inside the boundary. Fourth stage: the order-iso RigidifiedConstruction is sourced by 5.3.10 (no empty blowups) and 5.5.3 (synchronization); cartesian comparisons for any strict inert map are sourced by Cor 5.4.4. No hollow data, single sorry, docstrings present, statement fields verbatim. Dep repair changes only the module header; its one importer is a non-module file.
